applicabilityBasis.summary: Historical WEMIX$ was an ecosystem settlement stablecoin whose whitepaper describes USDC collateral and DIOS mint/burn market stabilization, not proven fiat reserves or an issuer obligation to redeem in monetary value. The transition supported conversion to bridged USDC.e; after the July 26, 2026 compromise, the September 21 update describes a separate restricted eqWEMIX$ compensation token exchangeable for USDC.e. Digital-asset conversion does not establish the GENIUS section 2(22) monetary-value obligation, so applicability is unclear for this frozen token.

genius.notes: WEMIX PTE. LTD. and Singapore domicile are retained from the existing row: the official Q1 report identifies this entity as a WEMIX Foundation member, but it does not resolve the exact WEMIX$ holder-liability issuer; no stronger legal mapping is claimed. Unsupported fiat-reserve, U.S.-person access and current market/supply assertions are removed. The March 2026 transition plan is historical; July's owner-key compromise halted related services, and September's compensation notice provides a distinct eqWEMIX$ -> USDC.e process, not normal current WEMIX$ fiat redemption. No current WEMIX$ reserve report, ordinary holder redemption policy or monthly attestation was verified; flags remain false. Applicability is corrected to unclear because the evidence establishes USDC/USDC.e mechanisms, not the required monetary-value redemption obligation. No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration was found. Foreign status remains unknown rather than incorrectly calling it not-applicable; proposed framework status does not exclude foreign-issuer obligations. The security incident is not regulator enforcement. Not-yet-restricted records pre-effective GENIUS timing, not live service availability. Independent verification on 2026-10-07 reopened every retained reference URL. The statutory applicability analysis is an editorial assessment rather than a regulator ruling.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07 the opened official federal framework sources and NYDFS regulated-entity and Greenlist sections, WEMIX primary disclosures, and bounded exact-name regulator searches did not establish a WEMIX$ PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration. Existing money-transmitter/trust frameworks or USDC backing would not transfer regulatory authorization. No public token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located. Frozen operation and compensation are not regulatory determinations; the exact legal token obligor remains uncertain.
